title.en: Brush Talks from Dream Brook: Six Notes on Nature

edition.en: Six entries from books 3, 7, 21 and 24, as given on Chinese Wikisource; the book headings are added for orientation. Shen Kuo’s account of Bi Sheng’s movable type, from book 18, is shelved separately as S-002041. Three evident misprints in the online text are corrected (已 for 己, 余 for 餘, 陜 for 陝). The entry from book 7 continues a conversation with a senior official about the calendar.
edition.zh: 据中文维基文库，选卷三、卷七、卷二十一、卷二十四共六条，卷名为便于查找而加。卷十八记毕昇活字一条另作 S-002041 上架。改正网上文本三处明显误字（“已”作“己”，“余”作“餘”，“陜”作“陝”）。卷七一条接续作者与上官讨论历法的问答。

basis.en: Song dynasty prose; the author died in 1095.
basis.zh: 宋代笔记，作者卒于 1095 年。

note.en: Shen Kuo was a Song official, engineer and astronomer who in retirement wrote down what he had seen and tested. These six notes include the earliest known statement that a magnetised needle points not quite south, an explanation of the moon’s phases with a powdered ball, a rainbow watched from both sides of a stream in Khitan country, fossil shells read as an old shoreline, and the prediction that rock oil would one day come into wide use; his entry on Bi Sheng’s movable type (活板) has its own shelf mark, S-002041. Notice how the note on the inverted image turns, without warning, into a remark about people.
note.zh: 沈括是宋代的官员、工程家和天文学家，晚年把一生所见、所试的事一条条写下来。这六条里有已知最早指出磁针“常微偏东，不全南”的记载，有用涂了粉的弹丸解释月相，有在契丹境内隔着溪涧从两边看过的一道彩虹，有把山崖里的螺蚌壳读作昔日的海岸，还有“此物后必大行于世”的石油预言；记毕昇活字的“活板”一条另有书架号 S-002041。请留意讲小孔成像的那一条，怎样不动声色地转到了人身上。

excerpt.orig: 不求去礙，而欲見不顛倒，難矣哉！
excerpt.en: If one does not try to remove what stands in the way, and still hopes to see things the right way up, that is hard indeed.
excerpt.zh: 不求去碍，而欲见不颠倒，难矣哉！

gloss.en: A concave mirror of polished bronze, used to light fires from the sun.
gloss.zh: 铜制的凹面镜，可对日取火。

gloss.en: The ‘art of crossing’: the mathematicians’ name for reasoning about rays that cross at a point.
gloss.zh: 算家称光线交叉成像的道理为“格术”。格，阻隔、交叉。

gloss.en: Sculling with a single oar over the stern. The oarlock (臬) is a pivot, so the blade moves opposite to the handle.
gloss.zh: 摇橹。橹臬是支点，所以橹叶的方向总与手柄相反。

gloss.en: A kite: the bird of prey, not the toy.
gloss.zh: 鸢，老鹰一类的猛禽。

gloss.en: 窻 is an old form of 窗: a crack in a window, which acts as a pinhole.
gloss.zh: 窻，同“窗”。窗缝，起到小孔的作用。

gloss.en: An hourglass-shaped drum, narrow at the waist: Shen Kuo’s picture of rays narrowing to a point and widening again.
gloss.zh: 两头粗、中间细的鼓。沈括用它比喻光线收束到一点再散开。

gloss.en: A hemp seed or a bean.
gloss.zh: 麻籽或豆粒。

gloss.en: To take the self for the other, and the other for the self: the inverted image turned into a remark about judgement.
gloss.zh: 把自己当作外物，把外物当作自己。由成像之理转说人的见识。

gloss.en: A Tang miscellany of marvels by Duan Chengshi (d. 863).
gloss.zh: 唐代段成式（？—863）所撰的笔记，多记奇闻异事。

gloss.en: The questioner is Shen Kuo’s superior, from the time when Shen was helping to revise the armillary sphere; this entry continues their conversation from the one before it.
gloss.zh: 发问的是沈括的上官。当时沈括参与详定浑天仪，此条接续上一条两人的问答。

gloss.en: They have form but no solid substance: in Song cosmology the sun and moon were made of qi.
gloss.zh: 有形状而没有实体。宋人认为日月由气构成。

gloss.en: In the Xining years (1068–1077). Shen Kuo’s embassy to the Liao court was in 1075.
gloss.zh: 熙宁年间（1068—1077）。沈括于 1075 年出使辽国。

gloss.en: The Khitan Liao empire, to the north of the Song.
gloss.zh: 契丹人建立的辽国，在宋朝北方。

gloss.en: To pitch a tent; 卓 is to set upright.
gloss.zh: 搭起帐篷。卓，竖立。

gloss.en: A hairpin, used as a verb: both ends of the rainbow were stuck down into the stream.
gloss.zh: 笄，簪子，这里用作动词，指彩虹两端像簪子一样插入涧中。

gloss.en: Fine silk gauze.
gloss.zh: 轻薄的丝织品。

gloss.en: Sun Sigong, courtesy name Yanxian, a Song mathematician and astronomer.
gloss.zh: 孙思恭，字彦先，北宋数学家、天文学家。

gloss.en: Fuzhou and Yanzhou in northern Shaanxi, around today’s Fu county and Yan’an, where Shen Kuo served on the frontier.
gloss.zh: 鄜州和延州，在今陕西富县、延安一带。沈括曾在此守边。

gloss.en: Rock oil: Shen Kuo’s name for it is the word still used for petroleum in Chinese.
gloss.zh: “石油”这个名称由沈括提出，至今仍用来称呼石油。

gloss.en: An old record that Gaonu county, near Yan’an, had a stream of fatty water that would burn; it goes back to the Han history.
gloss.zh: 旧说高奴县（在今延安附近）有可燃的“脂水”，见于《汉书·地理志》的记载。

gloss.en: Ink made from pine soot, the standard Chinese ink.
gloss.zh: 用松树烧出的烟灰制成的墨，是传统的墨。

gloss.en: Bare, stripped of trees, like a shaven head.
gloss.zh: 山上没有草木，光秃秃的。

gloss.en: Coal.
gloss.zh: 煤。

gloss.en: The dust of Luoyang was proverbial; the poet Lu Ji wrote that in the capital’s dust a white robe turns black.
gloss.zh: 洛阳尘土之多是有名的。陆机诗有“京洛多风尘，素衣化为缁”。

gloss.en: In legend Gun, father of Yu the Great, failed to tame the flood and was banished, or by some accounts put to death, at Mount Yu.
gloss.zh: 传说鲧（大禹之父）治水失败，被尧放逐（一说诛杀）于羽山。

gloss.en: Masters of techniques: diviners and geomancers, who first used the compass.
gloss.zh: 方术之士，如占卜、看风水的人，他们最早使用指南针。

gloss.en: Magnetic declination, the difference between magnetic and true south: this is its earliest known record.
gloss.zh: 即磁偏角，磁针所指与正南方向的偏差。这是已知最早的记载。

gloss.en: A single silk filament drawn from one cocoon, with almost no twist to resist the needle.
gloss.zh: 从一个蚕茧抽出的单根丝，几乎没有扭力，不妨碍磁针转动。

gloss.en: An old belief that cypress trees lean towards the west.
gloss.zh: 古人相信柏树的枝干偏向西方。

note.en: Six notes from a retired official who tested what he saw, including the first known record of magnetic declination; curiosity this exact is rare in any century.
note.zh: 一位退隐官员把所见一一验证后写下，其中有已知最早的磁偏角记录；这样精确的好奇心在任何时代都罕见。
